extensions.unitPolicy: Normative geometry is dp; typography inherits native Material 3 Typography() in scalable sp. No CSS pixel conversion is normative.

motion.name: gallery-paging
motion.purpose: Swipe or arrow-button paging; disabled while zoomed.

nativeComponents.name: MediaThumbnail
nativeComponents.behavior: Independent accessible button; crops media; spoiler concealment; format badge; loading/error icons.

nativeComponents.name: ThreadRow
nativeComponents.behavior: Separate media, discussion, and bookmark actions; two-line title and preview. Home adds a primary-colored, single-line label-small board and relative-age line above the title with 5dp bottom padding.

nativeComponents.name: SearchField
nativeComponents.behavior: Native outlined single-line input with search icon and conditional clear action; Material large shape.

nativeComponents.name: Native buttons
nativeComponents.behavior: Material Button, OutlinedButton, TextButton and IconButton; native interaction and disabled states.

nativeComponents.name: FilterChip
nativeComponents.behavior: Native selected state for Home Active/Newest ordering, catalog sorting, Nested/Chronological reply layout, and theme choice.

nativeComponents.name: Navigation
nativeComponents.behavior: Home, Boards, Saved, Settings; bottom bar or width-dependent rail.

nativeComponents.name: MediaViewer
nativeComponents.behavior: Fit initially; pinch 1–5x; double-tap 1x/3x; bounded pan; paging only while unzoomed; back preserves reader. White attachment-download action opens a native local-only save picker; inline body-small status and picker errors.

nativeComponents.name: Quote dialog
nativeComponents.behavior: Native AlertDialog with scrollable reply and optional media.

nativeComponents.name: Home timeline
nativeComponents.behavior: Compact favorite-board ThreadRows with board and relative-age labels; Active uses last-modified age and Newest uses creation age. Existing typography, spacing, filter chips, loading rows, and error/empty states are reused.

nativeComponents.name: Reply layout
nativeComponents.behavior: Native Nested/Chronological filter chips. Nested replies indent 12dp per depth capped at 36dp beyond the base inset; counted Show/Hide controls collapse descendants. Reply-reference text buttons wrap with 4dp gaps and open quote dialogs.

nativeComponents.name: Saved offline status
nativeComponents.behavior: Rows distinguish saving, discussion available offline, and bookmark-only status; Download discussion appears when missing, with native error text. Offline reader displays saved age and separately loaded media notice.

nativeComponents.name: Local backup
nativeComponents.behavior: Native folder and import controls with optional stop-updating action, busy progress, inline results, and restore confirmation. Existing 20dp inset and 8dp spacing. Local-only pickers; two latest completed timestamped JSON files in the chosen folder, no cloud or account; media and proxy passwords excluded.

extensions.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS component previews or synthetic tonal ramps are supplied: these would be approximations of native Compose, not extracted implementation. Native component inventory is provided instead.

narrative.overview:
Boardwalk uses a quiet green native Android interface around dense, readable conversations. Small images share the feed with short text previews; media gets its own black, full-screen surface when opened. This describes the implemented direction, not a new brand identity. Boardwalk remains a provisional name.

The implementation uses Jetpack Compose Material 3 with explicit light and dark color schemes. Preserve native controls and accessibility semantics. Dimensions below are Android density-independent units (`dp`); text uses inherited, scalable Material typography (`sp`), not CSS pixels.
keyCharacteristics: Green accents, restrained neutral surfaces, and explicit theme choices.
Black media viewing with pinch, double-tap, and paging controls.
dos: **Do** preserve separate thumbnail, discussion, and bookmark targets.
**Do** use theme roles and verify both light and dark appearance.
**Do** retain native dp geometry, scalable typography, system insets, and accessible action labels.
**Do** preserve list position when closing full-screen media.
donts: **Don't** turn the compact conversation feed into oversized image cards.
**Don't** page the gallery while a user is panning a zoomed image.
**Don't** invent web hover treatments, fixed pixel typography, or custom shadows absent from the native app.
**Don't** imply official 4chan branding or treat the provisional app name as an approved identity.
